posts.title: The Life of Toyotomi Hideyoshi
posts.description: Towards the end of the 16th century, Toyotomi Hideyoshi single-handedly rebuilt Kyoto and changed the course of Japanese history for the next centuries. posts.title: Keigo Higashino (1958-2026)
posts.description: Keigo Higashino, one of Japan’s most widely acclaimed author of mystery novels, died on July 23 this year from colorectal cancer. Born in Osaka in 1958, he started writing in high school but after university in 1981 began work as an engineer at Nippon Denso Co.
